## Rule

**Generator-proven (ARC-GEN `ce22a75a`, `tasks/task_ce22a75a.py` read directly).** Grid is **ALWAYS 9×9** — `generate()` is called with no args, so `size=3` is hardcoded and `grid = common.grid(size*size, size*size) = 9×9`. Input contains only colors **{0 bg, 5 gray}**; output only **{0 bg, 1 blue}** (verified over 5000 fresh generator samples: all shapes (9,9), input colors {0,5}, output colors {0,1}).

Every gray (color 5) cell sits at a **3×3-block center** `(3r+1, 3c+1)` for `r,c ∈ {0,1,2}`. Its **full 3×3 block** is painted **blue (color 1)**. The gray cell itself becomes blue (gray disappears). Background not in any gray-block stays background.

LIVE is a single `Conv[10,10,3,3]` (`mdc_w`, 900 params, 89% zeros). Decoded semantics:
- `out1 = ch1_in + nb5_full` where `nb5_full` = 3×3 ones-conv of ch5 (gray). `ch1_in≡0`, so `out1 = nb5_full` (blue count).
- `out0 = ch0_in − nb5_8` where `nb5_8` = 8-neighborhood gray count. Equals `1 − nb5_full` over the 9×9 grid (since `ch0+ch5≡1` everywhere in the full 9×9, and `nb5_full = nb5_8 + ch5`; holds byte-identically for both bg and gray cells).
- `out5 ≡ 0` (gray dropped). `out{2,3,4,6,7,8,9}` = passthrough of all-zero input channels ≡ 0.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
# input grid 9x9, colors in {0,5}; output 9x9, colors in {0,1}
gray = (grid == 5)                       # gray flags, only at block centers (3r+1,3c+1)
blue = dilate3x3(gray)                   # full 3x3 block of every gray -> blue
out  = np.where(blue, 1, 0)              # bg(0) elsewhere; gray cells become blue too
# Equivalent block-level view (used by the cost-442 build):
#   centers = gray[1::3, 1::3]           # [3,3] per-block gray indicator
#   blue9x9 = nearest_upsample(centers, 3)   # each block cell -> 3x3
```

## Cost analysis

**Only the tensor named `output` is memory-free (the scorer skips `input`/`output`).** So cost = `params(element-counts) + Σ(charged node-output tensors, bytes)`.
- LIVE (900): single conv, output is `output` → 0 intermediates → cost = 900 params. The 900 is the `[10,10,3,3]` weight element count and is **irreducible for a full-output single conv** (groups can't express the cross-channel ch5 read).
- To go lower you crop the compute (cheap intermediates) and reassemble into the free `output` via a final Pad. The dominant charged tensor is the **`[1,2,9,9]` plane** (ch0+ch1 over the 9×9 grid before Pad). **In U8 that is 162 B, not 324 (F16).** Both channels are forced by the **`>0`-per-channel decode** (`tools/ng_harness/encode.py:decode_to_grid` + `neurogolf_utils.run_network`): a cell with no positive channel decodes to −1 (invalid), so background needs ch0>0 over the full 9×9. 9×9 is generator-forced; U8 is the min itemsize **Resize** accepts (bool has NO Resize kernel in ORT — verified `Resize(13) NOT_IMPLEMENTED` on bool; F16 doubles it).
- **The Conv was the tax.** A Conv (no U8 kernel) forces an F16 plane → 324. **Dropping the Conv and keeping the plane U8 end-to-end** (`Cast` for ch1, `Equal→Cast` for the ch0 inverse — ⚠ no U8 arithmetic kernel, so no `Sub`/`Add`) lands the plane at U8 162. The cost-442 F16 build is superseded.

### Structural floor = 268 (proven; cannot beat ~240)

Charged tensors of the U8 ship (mem 243): `up`[1,2,9,9] U8 **162** + `centers`[1,1,3,3] **F32 36** (Slice of F32 input — Slice preserves dtype; no slice+cast fused op) + `bb`[1,2,3,3] U8 **18** (Resize input) + `c_u8` **9** (ch1, Concat operand) + `inv_u8` **9** (ch0, Concat operand) + `inv_b` **9** (bool, the only pure transient). params 25 = Slice(12)+`zero_f`(1)+`scales`(4)+`pad_amt`(8).
- `up`(162), `bb`(18), the two Concat operands (18), and the F32 `centers`(36) are all load-bearing/irreducible. Output must be [1,10,30,30] (gates compare `>0` byte-equal to `encode_grid`'s [1,10,30,30] and to LIVE), so the Pad and its [1,2,9,9] input are mandatory.
- Removing the lone `inv_b`(9) always costs ≥9 elsewhere (Not→still bool; Sub→F32 [1,1,3,3]=36; bool-concat-then-one-Cast→extra [1,2,3,3]=18). **The ~240 target double-counted: `c_u8`+`inv_u8` (18 of the cited "27 B transients") are the required Concat operands.** Measured alternatives (two-channel slice 276; bool-concat 277; Not variants 276/277; bool-output Resize → ORT rejects) all ≥ 268.
- profile_cost == static (268) — exact ship, no dynamic-shape gap. **268 is the floor; it ships.**

## Don't-do log

- **Don't keep the full-output single conv hoping to shrink it** — groups/depthwise can't express out0/out1 reading the far ch5 across any contiguous channel split. Full-output conv floor = 900.
- **Don't passthrough channels 2–9 via Slice+Concat** (the prompt's literal wording) — those slices are `[1,k,30,30]` F32 intermediates (3600 B each), far worse than 900. Channels 2–9 (and out5) are **always 0** on this generator → just zero-fill them with the free Pad.
- **Don't do the neighborhood compute on the full 9×9 ch5 slice** (cost 847) — the `[1,1,9,9]` F32 slice (324) + cast (162) dominate. Operate at the 3×3 block level (slice the 9 centers = 36) and Resize ×3.
- **Don't use F32** — all intermediate values are exactly {0,1}; F16 is lossless here and halves the dominant plane.
- **Don't keep a Conv (or any float plane) when the values are {0,1} — go U8 end-to-end.** The Conv has no U8 kernel → forces an F16 [1,2,9,9] plane (324). Dropping the Conv and building the plane in U8 (`Cast` ch1; `Equal→Cast` ch0 inverse) halves the dominant plane to 162 (cost 442 → 268, the REWORK win). ⚠ **No U8 arithmetic kernel in ORT** — use `Equal→Cast` for the inverse, never `Sub`/`Add` on U8 (graph rejected). ⚠ **No bool Resize kernel** either (`Resize(13) NOT_IMPLEMENTED` on bool) — the upsampled plane must be U8 (min itemsize), not bool.
- **Don't chase below 268 — it's the proven structural floor.** `up`(162)+`bb`(18)+two Concat operands(18)+F32 `centers`(36)+lone bool `inv_b`(9) = 243 mem, +25 params. The only pure transient (`inv_b`, 9) can't be removed for <9. Every measured alternative (two-channel slice 276, bool-concat 277, Not variants 276/277) regresses. Don't loop.
- **Don't fear the `shift` adversarial 0/1060** — content moved off the top-left 9×9 never occurs (generator grid is fixed 9×9 at top-left). Advisory-only per `core.md`.
